comingLast.roast: hide his keys, hide his phone, keep him at the bar
needs 5 from 2 - his playing group has started the commentary
on 14 with 5 to play - scratch the plan, just add points, any points
on 21 with 1 to go - the blue balls can smell the clubhouse
2 holes between him and a very memorable presso
3 from his last 3 - grandstand finish at the wrong end
on 18 - every one of his remaining 4 holes is now appointment viewing
5 holes for a jailbreak - 4 points cuts the wire
at 1.4 a hole he is on track for the full ceremony
Hope needs him to stay exactly this bad for 4 more holes
